reader.requirement: At --std 85 a CLOSE of a relative file is executed only for a file in an open mode: a CLOSE of a file never opened, already closed, or whose OPEN failed is unsuccessful with I-O status 42 (§1985:VIII.1.3.4 (5) b), performs no closing action (a CLOSE WITH LOCK that fails locks nothing), and runs an applicable USE procedure; each file-name of a multi-file CLOSE is judged separately (GR7).

edition-consulted.switches: DialectBehavior.CloseWithLockLocksFileConnector: after a SUCCESSFUL close WITH LOCK, 85 locks the physical file, 2002+ the file connector; the not-open guard (42, nothing locked) precedes it on both arms
Constructs.CloseWithLockRemoved2023: WITH LOCK accepted at 85 (printed in the 1985 relative CLOSE format), refused COBOL0902 at 2023

reader.edition-search: grep Edition/DialectBehavior in FileRegistry.cs close path, SequentialIoEmitter.EmitClose and SequentialIoBinder.BindClose; grep closeOption/CloseStatement in Validation; the GR1 guard in CloseCell and FileConnector.Close consults no edition.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: the not-open guard is the same at every edition; WITH LOCK (accepted at 85, removed at 2023) and what a successful WITH LOCK locks differ, which is beside this rule.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: pb140_close_status covers a sequential file's 42; the relative organization, a CLOSE after a failed OPEN, WITH LOCK on a not-open file, the multi-file CLOSE and the USE procedure are exercised only by this slice's probes

probes.printed: NEVER-OPEN=42; OPEN-ABSENT=35; AFTER-FAIL=42; OPENOUT=00; CLOSE1=00; CLOSE2=42; REOPEN=00; MULTI=00 00; MULTI2=00 42 (CLOSE RB RA with RB closed); LOCK=00; LOCKED-OPEN=38; USE-RC 42 / RC-NOTOPEN=42; RC-LOCK=00; USE-RC 42 / RC-LOCK2=42
probes.expected: CLOSE only for an open file: 42 otherwise, including after a failed (35) OPEN; each file of a multi-file CLOSE separately; USE AFTER STANDARD ERROR runs for 42; a successful WITH LOCK locks (38 on reopen)

probes.expected: the 1985 relative CLOSE format is CLOSE file-name-1 [WITH LOCK]: REEL/UNIT/NO REWIND refused, WITH optional

reader.notes: CloseCell hoists the not-open guard ahead of every closing action and sets 42; CloseWithLock locks only after a successful close, so a failed CLOSE WITH LOCK leaves the file openable. The multi-file CLOSE is emitted as one implicit CLOSE per file-name.
